items.name: Tomato
items.about: The most rewarding kitchen-garden crop.
howToSteps: Best started: winter (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large (15+ litres) pot.
Stake it early. Pinch side shoots for bigger fruit.

items.name: Chilli (Mirchi)
items.about: Prolific and pretty. One plant gives handfuls.
howToSteps: Best started: summer · monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a medium pot.
Let the soil dry slightly between waterings.

items.name: Brinjal (Baingan)
items.about: A sturdy plant with glossy purple fruit.
howToSteps: Best started: monsoon · winter (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large pot.
Feed with compost every few weeks.

items.name: Okra (Bhindi)
items.about: Loves heat and grows fast.
howToSteps: Best started: summer · monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a medium pot.
Pick pods young and tender, every two days.

items.name: Spinach (Palak)
items.about: Cut-and-come-again greens for months.
howToSteps: Best started: winter (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun to partial and a wide, shallow pot.
Harvest outer leaves and let the centre keep growing.

items.name: Fenugreek (Methi)
items.about: One of the fastest crops you can grow.
howToSteps: Best started: winter (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a wide, shallow pot.
Sow thickly; harvest by snipping.

items.name: Radish (Mooli)
items.about: Quick roots for impatient gardeners.
howToSteps: Best started: winter (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a deep pot.
Thin seedlings so each root has space.

items.name: Carrot (Gajar)
items.about: Sweet winter roots, best in loose soil.
howToSteps: Best started: winter (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a deep pot.
Keep the soil moist while seeds germinate.

items.name: Bottle gourd (Lauki)
items.about: A vigorous climber with big fruit.
howToSteps: Best started: summer · monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large pot.
Give it a trellis or terrace railing to climb.

items.name: French beans
items.about: Climbing or bush beans, generous and quick.
howToSteps: Best started: monsoon · winter (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a medium pot.
Pick often to keep them producing.

items.name: Peas (Matar)
items.about: Sweet pods straight from the vine.
howToSteps: Best started: winter (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a medium pot.
Give them a small net or sticks to climb.

items.name: Lettuce
items.about: Crisp salad leaves for cool months.
howToSteps: Best started: winter (approximate; check locally).
Give it partial sun and a shallow pot.
Shade it from harsh afternoon sun.

items.name: Cucumber (Kheera)
items.about: A summer climber with crunchy fruit.
howToSteps: Best started: summer (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large pot.
Water regularly; dry soil makes them bitter.

items.name: Spring onion
items.about: Regrow from kitchen scraps in a glass or pot.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a small pot.
Replant the white root ends from the market bunch.

items.name: Tulsi (Holy basil)
items.about: A sacred, fragrant household herb.
howToSteps: Best started: summer · monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a medium pot.
Pinch off flower spikes to keep it bushy.

items.name: Mint (Pudina)
items.about: Grows from a market sprig and spreads happily.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it partial sun and a medium pot.
Give it its own pot. It takes over.

items.name: Coriander (Dhaniya)
items.about: The everyday kitchen herb.
howToSteps: Best started: winter (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun to partial and a wide, shallow pot.
Crush the seeds lightly before sowing.

items.name: Curry leaf (Kadi patta)
items.about: A small tree with leaves for every tadka.
howToSteps: Best started: summer · monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large pot.
Grows slowly at first; be patient.

items.name: Lemongrass
items.about: Citrusy grass for chai and soups.
howToSteps: Best started: summer · monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a medium pot.
Root a market stalk in water first.

items.name: Ajwain leaf (Karpooravalli)
items.about: Fleshy, aromatic leaves, a home remedy favourite.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it partial sun and a small pot.
Grows easily from a cutting.

items.name: Sweet basil
items.about: The basil of pesto and pasta.
howToSteps: Best started: summer (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a small pot.
Pinch the tips to make it bushy.

items.name: Ginger (Adrak)
items.about: Grow from a sprouting market rhizome.
howToSteps: Best started: summer · monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it partial sun and a wide pot.
Plant a piece with a visible bud just under the soil.

items.name: Turmeric (Haldi)
items.about: Lush leaves and golden roots.
howToSteps: Best started: summer · monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it partial sun and a wide pot.
Plant a fresh rhizome before the monsoon.

items.name: Garlic (Lehsun)
items.about: Plant single cloves and harvest whole bulbs.
howToSteps: Best started: winter (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a medium pot.
Plant cloves pointy end up.

items.name: Marigold (Genda)
items.about: India's festival flower, and loved by bees.
howToSteps: Best started: winter · monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a medium pot.
Deadhead spent flowers for more blooms.

items.name: Hibiscus (Gudhal)
items.about: Big, bold blooms nearly all year.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large pot.
Feed regularly and water well in summer.

items.name: Rose (Gulab)
items.about: The classic garden flower.
howToSteps: Best started: winter (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large pot.
Prune after flowering; give plenty of sun.

items.name: Jasmine (Mogra)
items.about: Fragrant white summer flowers.
howToSteps: Best started: summer (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a medium pot.
Prune after the flowering season.

items.name: Sunflower
items.about: Tall, cheerful and easy for children to grow.
howToSteps: Best started: summer (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large pot.
Sow directly where it will grow.

items.name: Zinnia
items.about: Bright, butterfly-friendly blooms.
howToSteps: Best started: summer · monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a medium pot.
Water at the base to keep leaves dry.

items.name: Petunia
items.about: Colourful winter balcony flowers.
howToSteps: Best started: winter (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a small pot.
Pinch back leggy stems.

items.name: Periwinkle (Sadabahar)
items.about: Flowers almost every day of the year.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun to partial and a small pot.
Tolerates heat and neglect.

items.name: Portulaca (9 o'clock flower)
items.about: Opens bright flowers in the morning sun.
howToSteps: Best started: summer (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a small pot.
Grows from cuttings; loves heat.

items.name: Bougainvillea
items.about: A riot of colour that thrives in heat.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large pot.
Flowers best when slightly under-watered.

items.name: Chrysanthemum (Guldaudi)
items.about: The star of winter flower shows.
howToSteps: Best started: monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a medium pot.
Pinch tips until late monsoon for more buds.

items.name: Cosmos
items.about: Airy, daisy-like flowers that self-seed.
howToSteps: Best started: summer · monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a medium pot.
Poor soil gives more flowers.

items.name: Money plant (Pothos)
items.about: The classic Indian houseplant: grows in water or soil.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it low to bright indirect and a small pot.
Root a cutting in a bottle of water.

items.name: Snake plant
items.about: Nearly indestructible upright leaves.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it low to bright indirect and a medium pot.
Water only when completely dry.

items.name: ZZ plant
items.about: Glossy leaves that handle neglect.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it low light and a medium pot.
Water every few weeks.

items.name: Spider plant
items.about: Arching leaves that make baby plants.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it bright indirect and a small pot.
Pot up the babies to share with friends.

items.name: Peace lily
items.about: White flowers indoors; droops when thirsty.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it low to medium light and a medium pot.
Water when it droops; it bounces back.

items.name: Areca palm
items.about: A feathery indoor palm.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it bright indirect and a large pot.
Keep the soil lightly moist.

items.name: Rubber plant
items.about: Big, glossy, dark leaves.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it bright indirect and a large pot.
Wipe the leaves to keep them shiny.

items.name: Syngonium
items.about: Arrow-shaped leaves in pinks and greens.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it bright indirect and a small pot.
Grows easily from cuttings.

items.name: Aglaonema (Chinese evergreen)
items.about: Patterned leaves for darker corners.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it low to medium light and a medium pot.
Keep it away from cold drafts.

items.name: Lucky bamboo
items.about: Grows in a vase of water and pebbles.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it low to medium light and a vase of water pot.
Change the water every week or two.

items.name: Aloe vera
items.about: Soothing gel and endless baby plants.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it bright light and a medium pot.
Water sparingly; let it dry out.

items.name: Jade plant
items.about: A chunky little tree, said to bring luck.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it bright light and a small pot.
Grows from a single leaf or cutting.

items.name: Echeveria
items.about: Rose-shaped succulents in soft colours.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it bright light and a small pot.
Water at the soil, not into the rosette.

items.name: Haworthia
items.about: Small, striped and happy indoors.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it bright indirect and a small pot.
Handles less light than most succulents.

items.name: Kalanchoe
items.about: A succulent with clusters of bright flowers.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it bright light and a small pot.
Pinch spent flowers for repeat blooms.

items.name: Bunny ears cactus (Opuntia)
items.about: Paddle-shaped pads, easy from a cutting.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a small pot.
Handle with care: tiny spines.

items.name: Lemon (Nimbu)
items.about: Fragrant flowers and your own lemons.
howToSteps: Best started: any time (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large pot.
Start from a nursery sapling, not a seed.

items.name: Papaya
items.about: Grows fast from seed.
howToSteps: Best started: summer · monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large or ground pot.
Plant a few; some plants won't fruit.

items.name: Strawberry
items.about: Sweet winter berries in a pot or hanging basket.
howToSteps: Best started: winter (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a medium pot.
Grows best in the cool season.

items.name: Guava (Amrood)
items.about: A hardy fruit tree that suits containers too.
howToSteps: Best started: monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large or ground pot.
Choose a dwarf variety for pots.

items.name: Pomegranate (Anaar)
items.about: Orange-red flowers and jewel-like fruit.
howToSteps: Best started: monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large pot.
Loves sun and little water.

items.name: Neem
items.about: A hardy, much-loved native tree.
howToSteps: Best started: monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a in the ground pot.
Plant during the monsoon for easy rooting.

items.name: Moringa (Drumstick)
items.about: Fast-growing with nutritious leaves and pods.
howToSteps: Best started: monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large or ground pot.
Grows from a thick cutting.

metadata.First reward: Leaves in months, pods in a year

items.name: Jamun
items.about: A native shade tree with purple summer fruit.
howToSteps: Best started: monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a in the ground pot.
Give it space to spread.

items.name: Gulmohar
items.about: Fiery red-orange summer flowers.
howToSteps: Best started: monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a in the ground pot.
Plant away from walls; roots spread.

items.name: Champa (Frangipani)
items.about: Fragrant temple flowers on a small tree.
howToSteps: Best started: summer · monsoon (approximate; check locally).
Give it full sun and a large or ground pot.
Grows from a cutting dried for a week.
